## Batch jobs

Submit work and follow it through the queue — status, output, and why it failed.

### `list_jobs`

List z/OS batch jobs filtered by owner, name prefix, status, or return code. Supports result capping.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `owner` | string | no | Owner (user id) filter (max 8 chars). Use "*" for all. Defaults to "*". |
| `prefix` | string | no | Job name prefix filter, wildcards allowed (e.g. "PAY*"). Defaults to "*". |
| `status` | `INPUT` \| `ACTIVE` \| `OUTPUT` | no | Optional lifecycle status filter applied after retrieval. |
| `returnCode` | string | no | Optional return-code prefix filter (case-insensitive), e.g. "ABEND", "JCL ERROR", "CC 00". |
| `maxResults` | integer | no | Maximum number of jobs to return (default: server configured maxJobListResults). |

### `get_job_status`

Get the current status, return code, and failure indicator for a specific job. Optionally includes spool file inventory.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jobId` | string | yes | JES job id, e.g. "JOB01234". |
| `jobName` | string | no | Optional job name for confirmation/disambiguation (max 8 chars). |
| `includeSpoolSummary` | boolean | no | When true, also list the spool DD inventory below the status block. |

### `get_job_output`

Retrieve spool output for a job. Lists spool files (with optional step filter), or returns one DD content (with optional text grep and line cap).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jobId` | string | yes | JES job id, e.g. "JOB01234". |
| `ddName` | string | no | DD name (e.g. "JESMSGLG"). Omit to list available spool files. |
| `stepName` | string | no | Filter spool inventory to files produced by this step name. Only used when ddName is omitted. |
| `searchText` | string | no | When reading a DD, return only lines containing this text (case-insensitive grep). Applied before line capping. |
| `maxLines` | integer | no | Maximum output lines returned (caps at server configuration maximum). |

### `submit_jcl`

Submit inline JCL to JES for execution. Supports optional wait-for-completion polling, and JOB card CLASS/NOTIFY overrides.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jcl` | string | yes | The complete inline JCL to submit (including the //JOB card). |
| `wait` | boolean | no | Whether to wait for the job to complete execution before returning. |
| `timeout` | integer | no | Maximum time to wait in seconds (defaults to 30, max 300). Only used when wait=true. |
| `jobClass` | string | no | Override the CLASS= parameter on the JOB card (single char, A-Z or 0-9). |
| `notify` | string | no | Override the NOTIFY= parameter on the JOB card (TSO user id, max 8 chars). |

### `analyze_job_failure`

Analyze a failed job: identify the abend code, failing/cancelled step, program, and a suggested fix. Produces a rich 3-section report.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jobId` | string | yes | JES job id of the failed job, e.g. "JOB01234". |
| `includeEvidence` | boolean | no | Include supporting spool evidence lines in the output (default: true). |
| `spoolDd` | string | no | Force analysis to read a specific DD instead of the auto-priority list (e.g. "JESYSMSG"). |

### `get_job_jcl`

Retrieve the JCL that was submitted for a job (from JESJCLIN / JESJCL / JCL spool DDs). Supports custom line limit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jobId` | string | yes | JES job id, e.g. "JOB01234". |
| `maxLines` | integer | no | Maximum lines to return (caps at server configuration maximum). |

## Datasets

Find and read the mainframe's files: sequential datasets, libraries, and members.

### `list_datasets`

List catalog datasets matching a high-level qualifier (and optional pattern). Supports filtering by DSORG and capping result count.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hlq` | string | yes | High-level qualifier, e.g. "SYS1". |
| `pattern` | string | no | Optional lower-qualifier pattern appended to the HLQ, e.g. "PROC*". |
| `dsorg` | `PO` \| `PS` \| `DA` | no | Filter by dataset organisation: PO (PDS/PDSE), PS (sequential), DA (direct access). |
| `maxResults` | integer | no | Maximum number of datasets to return (default: all matched up to server limit). |

### `read_dataset`

Read the content of a sequential dataset or a PDS member (output is line-capped). Supports custom line limits and EBCDIC encoding hints.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dsn` | string | yes | Dataset name, e.g. "SYS1.PROCLIB". |
| `member` | string | no | PDS member name (1–8 chars). Omit for a sequential dataset. |
| `maxLines` | integer | no | Maximum lines to return (caps at server configuration maximum). |
| `encoding` | `utf8` \| `ibm1047` | no | Text encoding hint. Use "ibm1047" for EBCDIC datasets that the Zowe SDK may not auto-convert. |

### `search_dataset`

Search the catalog for datasets matching a wildcard pattern. Supports DSORG filter and result capping.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pattern` | string | yes | Dataset name pattern with wildcards, e.g. "PROD.**.LOADLIB". Must contain at least one "." or "*". |
| `dsorg` | `PO` \| `PS` \| `DA` | no | Filter by dataset organisation: PO (PDS/PDSE), PS (sequential), DA (direct access). |
| `maxResults` | integer | no | Maximum number of datasets to return (default: all matched up to server limit). |

### `search_members`

Search for members in a PDS, optionally filtered by wildcard pattern. Supports extended stats, result capping, and sorting.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dsn` | string | yes | PDS dataset name, e.g. "SYS1.PROCLIB". |
| `pattern` | string | no | Member name pattern with "*"/"?" wildcards, e.g. "IKJ*". Omit to list all. |
| `includeStats` | boolean | no | Fetch extended member statistics: last-modifier userid, record count, and changed time. |
| `maxResults` | integer | no | Maximum number of members to return after filtering. |
| `sortBy` | `name` \| `modified` \| `size` | no | Sort order for results: "name" (default), "modified" (newest first), or "size" (largest first). |

### `get_dataset_info`

Get catalog attributes (DSORG, type, RECFM, LRECL, BLKSIZE, volume) for a dataset without reading its content. Optionally includes member summary for PDS/PDSE.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dsn` | string | yes | Fully-qualified dataset name, e.g. "SYS1.PROCLIB". |
| `includeMembers` | boolean | no | For PDS/PDSE: also retrieve member count and the 5 most-recently-modified members. |

## Unix files

Browse and read the Unix side of z/OS (USS).

### `list_uss_directory`

List the contents of a USS (Unix System Services) directory. Supports type filter, sort order, and result capping.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes | Absolute USS directory path, e.g. "/u/payroll". |
| `type` | `file` \| `directory` \| `symlink` \| `other` | no | Filter results to only entries of this type. |
| `sortBy` | `name` \| `size` \| `modified` \| `type` | no | Sort order: "name" (default, alpha), "size" (largest first), "modified" (newest first), "type" (dirs first). |
| `maxResults` | integer | no | Maximum number of entries to return after filtering and sorting. |

### `read_uss_file`

Read the contents of a USS file. Supports custom line limits and text grep filtering.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes | Absolute USS file path, e.g. "/u/payroll/run.log". |
| `maxLines` | integer | no | Maximum lines to return (caps at server configuration maximum). |
| `searchText` | string | no | Return only lines containing this text (case-insensitive). Applied before line capping. |

### `search_uss_files`

Search for files/directories in a USS directory matching a wildcard name pattern. Supports type filter, sort, and result capping.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes | Absolute USS directory path to search within. |
| `pattern` | string | yes | File/directory name pattern with "*"/"?" wildcards, e.g. "*.log" or "pay*". |
| `type` | `file` \| `directory` \| `symlink` \| `other` | no | Restrict matches to entries of this type only. |
| `sortBy` | `name` \| `size` \| `modified` \| `type` | no | Sort matched results: "name" (default), "size" (largest first), "modified" (newest first), "type" (dirs first). |
| `maxResults` | integer | no | Maximum number of matched entries to return. |

## Day-to-day operations

What broke, how often, and whether the system is healthy right now.

### `find_failed_jobs`

Find all failed jobs within a recent time window and summarize their abend/step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hours` | integer | no | Look-back window in hours. Defaults to 24. |
| `owner` | string | no | Owner filter. Defaults to "*" (all owners). |

### `summarize_abends`

Aggregate abend codes across recent failed jobs, with counts and a short description.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hours` | integer | no | Look-back window in hours. Defaults to 24. |
| `owner` | string | no | Owner filter. Defaults to "*" (all owners). |

### `system_health_summary`

Produce a high-level operational health snapshot: overall status (HEALTHY/DEGRADED/CRITICAL), active and queued jobs, recent failure count, top abend codes with descriptions, and per-owner failure breakdown.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lookbackHours` | integer | no | Scope the failed-job analysis to jobs that ended within this many hours. When omitted, all OUTPUT-status jobs with failure return codes are counted (no time filter). Set this to e.g. 24 to see only failures in the last day. |

### `investigate_incident`

Assemble a full incident bundle for a job: status, root-cause analysis (with abend reference), complete spool inventory, and diagnostic excerpts from all relevant DDs.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jobId` | string | yes | JES job id to investigate, e.g. "JOB01234". |
| `maxExcerptLines` | integer | no | Maximum lines to include from each diagnostic spool excerpt. Defaults to 80. Increase for a deeper view. |

### `lookup_abend_code`

Look up z/OS abend codes (S0C7, S806, S0C4, S322, S0CB, U4038, etc.) with explanations, common causes, and remediation steps. Supports catalog search and category filter.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | string | no | Abend code to look up, e.g. "S806", "0C7", "S0C7", or "U0100". Omit to list or search the full catalog. |
| `search` | string | no | Filter the catalog by code, title, explanation, or common-cause text (case-insensitive). |
| `category` | `system` \| `user` | no | Restrict results to "system" (Sxxx) or "user" (Uxxxx) codes. Omit to include both categories. |

### `verify_zosmf_connection`

Verify z/OSMF connectivity, authentication, and basic API availability.

_No arguments._

### `compare_jobs`

Compare status, return code, and failure indicators for two jobs side by side.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jobId1` | string | yes | First JES job id. |
| `jobId2` | string | yes | Second JES job id. |

### `get_user_jobs_summary`

Summarize job counts by status for a specific owner (active, queued, failed, completed).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `owner` | string | yes | User id (owner) to summarize, e.g. "PAYUSR". |
| `prefix` | string | no | Optional job name prefix filter. Defaults to "*". |

## Deeper analysis

Root-cause reports across several failures, and which jobs look likely to fail next.

### `analyze_root_cause`

Deep AI-assisted root-cause analysis: full failure details, abend reference, similar-incident correlation, correlated abends, health score, and prioritized action items.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jobId` | string | yes | JES job id of the failed job to analyze, e.g. "JOB01234". |
| `lookbackHours` | integer | no | Hours of history for correlation. Defaults to 72 (3 days), max 720 (30 days). |

### `predict_batch_failures`

Predict batch failure risk by scoring job names with recurring failures using a recency-weighted algorithm. Returns risk levels (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL), failure trends, and top abend codes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hours` | integer | no | Historical look-back window in hours. Defaults to 168 (7 days), max 720 (30 days). |
| `minFailures` | integer | no | Minimum number of failures a job must have in the window to appear in the report. Defaults to 1. |

## CICS regions

Inspect the transaction system that runs interactive workloads.

> **Needs configuration:** CMCI_CONTEXT

### `list_cics_regions`

List CICS regions in a CMCI context. Supports status filter and result capping.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | string | no | CMCI context (CICSplex name or region APPLID). Defaults to CMCI_CONTEXT env var. |
| `status` | string | no | Filter by region status, e.g. "ACTIVE", "INACTIVE". Case-insensitive. |
| `maxResults` | integer | no | Maximum number of regions to return after filtering. |

### `get_cics_region_status`

Get the current status, version, and attributes of a CICS region via CMCI.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `region` | string | yes | CICS region APPLID, e.g. "CICSPAY1" (max 8 chars). |
| `context` | string | no | CMCI context. Defaults to CMCI_CONTEXT env var. |

### `list_cics_transactions`

List CICS transaction definitions installed in a region via CMCI. Supports prefix/status filters and result capping.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `region` | string | yes | CICS region APPLID to query transactions for (max 8 chars). |
| `context` | string | no | CMCI context. Defaults to CMCI_CONTEXT env var. |
| `tranPrefix` | string | no | Filter to transactions starting with this prefix (e.g. "PAY"). Case-insensitive. |
| `status` | string | no | Filter by transaction status, e.g. "ACTIVE", "INACTIVE". |
| `maxResults` | integer | no | Maximum number of transactions to return after filtering. |

## Db2 databases

Look up the tables and views that exist in Db2.

> **Needs configuration:** DB2_LOCATION

### `list_db2_subsystems`

List Db2 subsystems (locations) available via Db2 REST (requires DB2_LOCATION).

_No arguments._

### `search_db2_catalog`

Search the Db2 catalog for tables, views, or aliases matching a name pattern. Includes row count, creation date, and remarks.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pattern` | string | yes | Table/view name pattern with wildcards (*, ?), e.g. "PAY*". |
| `schema` | string | no | Optional schema/creator filter (exact match), e.g. "PAYROLL". |
| `type` | string | no | Object type filter: "TABLE", "VIEW", "ALIAS", "MATERIALIZED QUERY TABLE". Case-insensitive. |
| `maxResults` | integer | no | Maximum number of catalog objects to return (default 50, max 200). |

## Performance metrics

Read the system's own performance records (SMF/RMF).

> **Needs configuration:** SMF_SUMMARY_DATASET or z/OSMF RMF

### `get_smf_metrics`

Retrieve SMF/RMF performance metrics from z/OSMF RMF and/or a configured SMF summary dataset. Supports category filtering.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | string | no | Filter metrics by category: "cpu", "io", "memory", "performance", "counter", or a custom keyword matching metric names. |

## Security and audit

Review RACF audit records and check which of this server's guardrails are on.

> **Needs configuration:** RACF_AUDIT_USS_PATH or RACF_AUDIT_DATASET (for the audit query)

### `query_racf_audit`

Query RACF security audit records from a configured USS path or dataset. Supports user, resource, event, result, class, and time-window filters.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `user` | string | no | Filter by user id (substring match, case-insensitive). |
| `resource` | string | no | Filter by resource name (substring match, case-insensitive). |
| `event` | string | no | Filter by event/access type, e.g. "READ", "UPDATE", "DELETE". Substring match. |
| `result` | string | no | Filter by result/outcome, e.g. "SUCCESS", "FAIL", "0". Substring match. |
| `class` | string | no | Filter by RACF resource class, e.g. "DATASET", "FACILITY", "PROGRAM". |
| `hours` | integer | no | Look-back window in hours (best-effort when timestamps are present). |
| `maxResults` | integer | no | Maximum number of audit records to return (default 100, capped server-side). |

### `security_posture_summary`

Report the server security posture: terms acknowledgement, read-only mode, tool allowlists, TLS, audit logging, resource boundaries, and tiered security recommendations.

_No arguments._
